description: Grades one answer from a start_quiz round. Returns whether it is correct, the correct answer, the explanation, its sources, the running score and the quiz_id for the next answer; after the last question it also returns the final score. The round's progress and score are held in the quiz_id, which changes with every answer, and grading stores nothing. A quiz_id grades each question once.

answer.description: multiple_choice and fill_blank: the index of the option, from 0. true_false: true or false. match_pairs: an array with, for each item of lefts in order, the index of its match in rights.

language.description: Language of the questions, options and explanations. Default en.

question_id.description: The id of the question in the round.

quiz_id.description: For the first answer of a round, the quiz_id from start_quiz. For each later answer, the quiz_id from the latest check_answer result. It holds the round's progress and score.

name: check_answer

quiz_id.description: The quiz_id for the next answer of this round

title: Check a quiz answer
